caption:
A 4.2-star average used to be plenty.

BrightLocal's 2026 survey of over 1,000 consumers found the share who'll only use a business rated 4.5 stars or higher nearly doubled in a year, from 17% to 31%.

Volume carries its own bar now too. 47% won't even consider a business with fewer than 20 reviews.

Recency matters almost as much as the rating itself. A profile that stopped collecting reviews months ago reads as abandoned, even with a strong average.

The fix: text the review link within 24 hours of every finished job, not just the ones that went well.

DM TRIAL to see review requests fire automatically the moment a job closes.

#ReviewGeneration #LocalBusinessMarketing #ReputationManagement #ServiceBusinessGrowth #SmallBusinessTips
rationale: Carousels lead 2026 saves/depth for B2B research content, and this translates a fresh, unclaimed BrightLocal 2026 finding (rating-threshold jump plus a 20-review volume floor) into a concrete 24-hour post-job ask cadence.
